title: Mode-I Method A/B Release Acceptance Matrix and Reproducibility Audit
governing_directive: Complete a dependable, reproducible Mode-I workflow; Method C is an optional research extension

golden_case.name: Method B Native Adaptive Remeshing (Pandey & Kumar 2025 Reproduction)

gate_1_golden_run_reproducibility.description: Method B full fracture propagation reproduces stable terminal softening to horizon u=0.010 mm

gate_2_miseseri_semantics.description: Posteriori stress recovery indicator (MISESERI) correctly extracted on facsimile set All_elem

gate_3_automatic_refinement_and_topology.description: Automatic remeshing generates graded mesh with duplicate slit-flank nodes at y=0.05 mm
gate_3_automatic_refinement_and_topology.slit_flank_conformance: Duplicate nodes along horizontal line y=0.05 mm, x <= 0.05 mm
gate_3_automatic_refinement_and_topology.crack_corridor_limitation: Refinement region geometrically bounded to crack corridor; arbitrary curving crack independence is NOT claimed

gate_4_configurable_loading_partitions.description: Pre-analysis stress recovery is invariant across 1S, 2S, and 4S step partitions

gate_5_rf_crack_energy_parity.description: Elastic stiffness K0 parity <= 0.05% and peak reaction force F_max parity <= 2.0% vs uniform reference

gate_6_dof_and_computational_savings.description: Pre-refinement achieves >70% DOF reduction and measured parallel speedup
gate_6_dof_and_computational_savings.adapted_vs_uniform15k_elements: 14,677 adapted vs 15,192 uniform (comparable tip density h=1.9 um with far-field coarsening)

gate_7_uel_source_and_hash_integrity.description: Production UEL f42_mixed_uel.for remains 100% bitwise frozen

gate_8_regression_coverage.description: Comprehensive regression test suite passing across all Mode-I verification stages

gate_9_state_transfer_benchmark_poc.description: Package 89 demonstrates single-step nonmatching transfer at crack initiation

gate_10_architecture_contract.description: Extensible 5-layer architecture specified with clear maturity classifications
gate_10_architecture_contract.implemented_verified: Mode-I 2D plane-strain sharp slit, Method A/B pre-refinement, Package 89 single transfer PoC
gate_10_architecture_contract.designed_prototyped: 5-layer decoupled engine, dual-element UEL state schema, acceptance matrix auditor
gate_10_architecture_contract.future_research_extension: Multi-cycle Method C sequential remeshing, Mode-II shear branching, 3D brick user elements
